tasks.title: Split payment: auto-fill cash remainder, correct change/receipt (F1)
tasks.brief: Files: index.html (checkout split box: #inputCardAmount/#inputCreditAmount/#inputCashReceived/#displayChangeDue and the receipt tender lines), tests/ux/split-payment-cash.mjs (new). Bug: in «مختلط» the cash field stays at the full total (92.00) after entering 40 card, so the modal shows change 40.00 and the receipt prints «المدفوع نقدًا 92.00 / الباقي 40.00» next to «نقدي 52.00 + بطاقة 40.00». Fix: on input of card/credit amount set cash received = total - card - credit (still editable), focus the cash field only if remainder > 0, change due computed from that, receipt shows cash tendered and change consistent with the tender split. Frontend-only; preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL; backend frozen; no deploy; do not edit .nova/cloud-queue.json or workflows. Source: .nova/qa/ux-pro3-report.md F1.
tasks.acceptance: tests/ux/split-payment-cash.mjs: total 92, card 40 -> cash field 52.00, change 0.00; receipt text has no «الباقي: 40.00»; card > total still rejected with toast; cash-only sale still 0 clicks and 4 keys (node tests/ux/sale-clicks.mjs passes); no console errors.

tasks.title: Search: Arabic generic-name and indication aliases, 1-letter typo tolerance (F4)
tasks.brief: Files: index.html (search function using foldKey/splitToks near the instant-search code), tests/ux/search-aliases.mjs (new). Gap: «اموكسيسيلين»، «ديكلوفيناك»، «باراسيتامول»، «مسكن صداع»، «كولسترول»، «بخاخ انف»، «سترزين» return nothing. Add a small static alias map (Arabic generic name and indication keyword -> the Latin generic already in the product records) and allow edit distance 1 per token of length >= 5 as a lower-ranked tier; exact/prefix matches must still rank first. Keep search under 10 ms for the 12 demo products and a 5,000 product list. Frontend-only; backend frozen; no deploy; do not edit .nova/cloud-queue.json or workflows. Source: .nova/qa/ux-pro3-report.md F4.
